→ A new product will be launched by the company next spring.
② You must not leave your bike in front of the entrance.
→ Your bike must not be left in front of the entrance.
③ Can they deliver the order by tomorrow morning?
→ Can the order be delivered by tomorrow morning?
④ Someone might have stolen the painting during the night.
→ The painting might be stolen during the night by someone.
⑤ The government should address this issue immediately.
→ This issue should be addressed by the government immediately.
questions.explanation: ④ might have stolen(완료형) → 수동태는 might have been stolen이어야 한다. might be stolen은 단순 수동태로 시제가 달라진다.

questions.question:
다음 중 두 문장의 뜻이 서로 같지 않은 것은?

= Plastic bottles should be recycled.
② They will announce the results tomorrow.
= The results will be announced tomorrow.
③ You must not park here after six o'clock.
= Parking here must not be allowed after six o'clock.
④ A doctor must examine the patient right away.
= The patient must be examined by a doctor right away.
⑤ The school may cancel the field trip due to the weather.
= The field trip may be canceled by the school due to the weather.
questions.explanation: ③ 원문: "주차하면 안 된다" (행위 금지) / 전환문: "주차가 허용되어서는 안 된다" (허용 금지) → 의미가 미묘하게 다르다. 정확한 수동태는 "Here must not be parked after six o'clock."

→ Endangered animals should be protected.

→ A new planet might be discovered soon.
③ The committee will select three finalists.
→ Three finalists will be selected by the committee.
④ You must hand in the report by Monday.
→ The report must be handed in by Monday.
⑤ He will teach us English grammar next semester.
→ English grammar will be taught us by him next semester.
questions.explanation: ⑤ will be taught us → will be taught to us (4형식→수동태 시 간접목적어 앞에 전치사 to 필요) 또는 We will be taught English grammar by him.

→ This issue should be addressed by the government immediately.

= The results will be announced tomorrow.

= The patient must be examined by a doctor right away.

= The field trip may be canceled by the school due to the weather.

ⓕ expect + 목적어 + to부정사: My teacher expects me to work harder. (working → to work)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ She had her room cleaned.
ⓑ I want her to come to the party.
ⓒ He made me to clean the kitchen.
ⓓ The teacher told us not to talk during the test.
ⓔ My coach let me to rest today.
ⓕ She allowed him to leave early.
questions.explanation:
ⓒ 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: He made me clean the kitchen. (to clean → clean)
ⓔ 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 원형부정사: My coach let me rest today. (to rest → rest)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ He wants her to not leave now.
ⓑ Who told you to come to the concert?
ⓒ My teacher asked me to take the quiz.
ⓓ They didn't want me to be late.
ⓔ My mother wants that I wake up early.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ ask + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ want + 목적어 + to부정사(부정): 올바른 문장.
ⓐ want + 목적어 + not to부정사: He wants her not to leave now. (to not → not to)
ⓔ want + 목적어 + to부정사: My mother wants me to wake up early. (wants that I → wants me to)

questions.question:
[Part 7] 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ He made his son to water the plants.
ⓑ He allowed me to go to the movies.
ⓒ He ordered the soldiers not to go out.
ⓓ I asked her to sing a song for us.
ⓔ Mike wanted me playing soccer after school.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ order + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ ask + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓐ 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: He made his son water the plants. (to water → water)
ⓔ want + 목적어 + to부정사: Mike wanted me to play soccer after school. (playing → to play)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ Dad allowed me went to a movie.
ⓑ They expect her to come to the party.
ⓒ My father advised me not to listen to music through earphones.
ⓓ I told you go outside after dinner.
ⓔ My mom allowed me playing the computer.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: Dad allowed me to go to a movie. (went → to go)
ⓓ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: I told you to go outside after dinner. (go → to go)
ⓔ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: My mom allowed me to play the computer. (playing → to play)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ He made me to clean my room.
ⓑ My father asked me to clean my room immediately.
ⓒ The doctor advised me to exercise regularly.
ⓓ My father allowed me playing computer games.
ⓔ He didn't allow his daughter to go abroad.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ ask + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ advise + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓔ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓐ 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: He made me clean my room. (to clean → clean)
ⓓ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: My father allowed me to play computer games. (playing → to play)

questions.question:
다음 문장의 <u>밑줄 친 부분</u> 중 생략할 수 있는 것은?
① She asked me <u>to</u> stop talking.
② He told them <u>to</u> read the article.
③ My mother forced me <u>to</u> exercise every morning.
④ He wanted foreigners <u>to</u> know Korean customs.
⑤ We helped the boys <u>to</u> finish their project in time.
questions.explanation:
help는 목적격 보어로 to부정사와 원형부정사를 모두 취할 수 있으므로 to를 생략할 수 있다.
We helped the boys finish their project in time. (O)
나머지 동사(ask, tell, force, want)는 반드시 to부정사를 사용해야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ She had her car washed.
ⓑ I want her to not come late.
ⓒ He made his son wash the dishes.
ⓓ The teacher told us not to talk during the quiz.
ⓔ My coach let me to rest for an hour.
ⓕ She allowed him to leave early.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ want + 목적어 + not to부정사: I want her not to come late. (to not → not to)
ⓔ 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 원형부정사: My coach let me rest for an hour. (to rest → rest)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ My mom often gets me wash the dishes.
ⓑ My mom wants me to take care of the baby.
ⓒ Her mom advised her to make a study plan.
ⓓ We watched him to play basketball.
ⓔ My aunt wants me to visit her this weekend.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ advise + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓔ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓐ get + 목적어 + to부정사: My mom often gets me to wash the dishes. (wash → to wash)
ⓓ 지각동사 watch + 목적어 + 원형부정사: We watched him play basketball. (to play → play)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ I want to know where she is going.
ⓑ He made me to clean the classroom.
ⓒ My coach asked me to practice every day.
ⓓ The doctor advised me not to skip meals.
ⓔ She let me to use her umbrella.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ want to know + 간접의문문: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ ask + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ advise + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: He made me clean the classroom. (to clean → clean)
ⓔ 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 원형부정사: She let me use her umbrella. (to use → use)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ She told her son to clean his room.
ⓑ The girl made the dog to stop barking.
ⓒ My father forced me to finish my report.
ⓓ The coach wanted the player to run faster.
ⓔ She advised her sister to stop eating late.
ⓕ His boots enable him to move quietly.
questions.explanation:
어색한 문장은 ⓑ 하나뿐이다.
ⓑ 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: The girl made the dog stop barking. (to stop → stop)
나머지 문장은 모두 어법상 올바르다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ He wants her to not leave now. (= He wants her not to leave now.)
ⓑ Who told you to come to the recital?
ⓒ My teacher asked me to retake the test.
ⓓ They didn't want me to be nervous.
ⓔ My mother wants that I get up at 7.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ ask + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ want + 목적어 + to부정사(부정): 올바른 문장.
ⓐ want + 목적어 + not to부정사: He wants her not to leave now. (to not은 비표준)
ⓔ want + 목적어 + to부정사: My mother wants me to get up at 7. (wants that I → wants me to)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ They wanted me to pass the test.
ⓑ He told me not to worry about that.
ⓒ Mom always tells me studying hard.
ⓓ Mom allowed me to buy a new bag.
ⓔ Mike persuaded me to join his art club.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓔ persuade + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: Mom always tells me to study hard. (studying → to study)

options: He wanted to be a teacher.
He wanted I be a teacher.
He wanted I to be a teacher.
He wanted me to be a teacher.
He wanted me be a teacher.
questions.question:
[Part 8] 다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
나는 그가 선생님이 되기를 원하셨다.
questions.explanation:
want + 목적어(목적격) + to부정사 구문을 사용한다.
주어가 원하는 대상이 "나"이므로 목적격 me를 사용: He wanted me to be a teacher.
② I be → 목적격 me 필요 + to 필요
③ I to be → 목적격 me 필요
⑤ me be → to 필요

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ I want to know who broke the vase.
ⓑ Do you think who will be her new partner?
ⓒ I'm wondering whether he is at home.
ⓓ What do you believe happened to her?
ⓔ I'm curious about what did she do last summer.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 간접의문문 어순(주어+동사): 올바른 문장.
ⓒ whether + 주어 + 동사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ think/believe류 동사는 의문사를 문두로 이동: What do you believe happened to her? 올바른 문장.
ⓑ think류 동사 + 의문사 → 의문사를 문두로: Who do you think will be her new partner?
ⓔ 간접의문문은 평서문 어순: what she did last summer (did she do → she did)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ She doesn't know where he is from.
ⓑ I don't understand why they are angry.
ⓒ I don't know if John and Tom are coming.
ⓓ When do you think they will finish?
ⓔ Nobody knows when the accident did happened.
questions.explanation:
ⓔ 조동사 did + 과거형 happened는 이중 과거로 어색하다: Nobody knows when the accident happened. (did happened → happened)
ⓐ 전치사로 끝나는 간접의문문: 엄격한 문법에서는 어색할 수 있다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은? (정답 2개)
① What movie do you know she wants to see?
② The student knows how it is hard to be a nurse.
③ I wonder whether you'd like to come to the party.
④ I'd like to know how many stars we can see at night.
⑤ Do you think which one is smarter, a cat or a dog?
questions.explanation:
③ wonder + whether절(간접의문문): 올바른 문장.
④ how many + 명사 + 주어 + 동사(간접의문문 어순): 올바른 문장.
① know는 think류가 아니므로 의문사 문두 이동 불가: Do you know what movie she wants to see?
② how + 형용사 + it is: The student knows how hard it is to be a nurse.
⑤ think류 동사 + which → 문두 이동: Which one do you think is smarter?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ I don't know that she will attend the event or not.
ⓑ Can you tell me when your birthday is?
ⓒ She asks me when we will meet.
ⓓ Do you know who did drew this picture?
ⓔ I don't know who is telling the truth.
ⓕ Do you think why she smiled?
questions.explanation:
ⓐ "~인지 아닌지"는 whether/if 사용: I don't know whether she will attend the event or not. (that → whether/if)
ⓓ 조동사 did + 과거형 drew는 이중 과거: Do you know who drew this picture? (did drew → drew)
ⓕ think류 동사 + why → 의문사 문두 이동: Why do you think she smiled? (Do you think why → Why do you think)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ I want to know where she studies.
ⓑ Do you know what song she wants to sing?
ⓒ What kind of job do I want to have?
ⓓ Do you think I should take a break?
ⓔ Do you think what I can do for you?
ⓕ What do you think you want to eat?
ⓖ The woman wants to know how much it is.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ think + yes/no 의문문(if/whether 없이 직접): 올바른 문장.
ⓕ think류 동사 + what → 문두 이동: 올바른 문장.
ⓖ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ 직접의문문이라면 맞지만 문맥상 간접의문문 의도.
ⓔ think류 동사 + what → 문두 이동 필요: What do you think I can do for you?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ Can you guess why they do this?
ⓑ Do you suppose what made her come here?
ⓒ I don't really know when is the class over.
ⓓ He asked me how often she helped him.
ⓔ Let's ask her who the man in the picture is.
ⓕ I'm not sure when he arrived at the station.
ⓖ I didn't know how I dealt with it.
ⓗ Do you think why he's so surprised?
questions.explanation:
ⓑ suppose류(think류) 동사 + what → 의문사 문두 이동: What do you suppose made her come here?
ⓒ 간접의문문은 평서문 어순: I don't really know when the class is over. (when is the class → when the class is)
ⓗ think류 동사 + why → 의문사 문두 이동: Why do you think he's so surprised?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?
(A) I told them to be quiet during the ceremony.
(B) She made him to clean the kitchen.
(C) My coach let me rest before the match.
(D) The teacher encouraged us to try again.
(E) He allowed her entered the building.
(F) They wanted me to pass the exam.
questions.explanation:
옳은 문장 4개: (A), (C), (D), (F)
(A) tell + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(C) 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 원형부정사: 올바른 문장.
(D) encourage + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(F) want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(B) 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: She made him clean the kitchen. (to clean → clean)
(E) allow + 목적어 + to부정사: He allowed her to enter the building. (entered → to enter)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ How can you believe she painted this herself?
ⓑ Why do you think he will arrive late?
ⓒ I don't know when she can help me.
ⓓ Do you imagine what the view looks like?
ⓔ Can you tell me where he went yesterday?
ⓕ Why do you think she would rather stay?
ⓖ Do you suppose what time she will arrive?
ⓗ Where do you know the bus stop is?
questions.explanation:
ⓓ imagine류(think류) + what → 의문사 문두 이동: What do you imagine the view looks like?
ⓖ suppose류(think류) + what time → 의문사 문두 이동: What time do you suppose she will arrive?
ⓗ know는 think류가 아니므로 의문사 문두 이동 불가하지만, "Where do you know the bus stop is?"는 어색하다: Do you know where the bus stop is?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ They wanted me to pass the exam.
ⓑ He told me not to worry about it.
ⓒ Mom always tells me studying hard.
ⓓ Mom allowed me to buy a new jacket.
ⓔ Mike persuaded me joining his club.
ⓕ The doctor advised her not to smoke.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓕ advise + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: Mom always tells me to study hard. (studying → to study)
ⓔ persuade + 목적어 + to부정사: Mike persuaded me to join his club. (joining → to join)

questions.question:
[Part 1] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
My teacher told me __________ harder for the test.
questions.explanation: tell+목적어+to부정사: told me to study

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
She asked him __________ the window.
questions.explanation: ask+목적어+to부정사: asked him to open

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
He __________ me to carry his luggage.
questions.explanation: ask+목적어+to부정사 구문이 가능한 동사는 asked이다. said/talked/spoke/cried는 to부정사 목적격 보어를 취하지 않는다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
My coach __________ me to get more sleep before the game.
questions.explanation: advise+목적어+to부정사: advised me to get. let/make/have는 원형부정사를 취하고, felt는 의미상 부적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
Mom __________ me to set the table before dinner.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
He __________ her to write the report.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
Dad __________ me to learn how to cook.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
She __________ me to take her advice seriously.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
I want Jake __________ me with my science project.
questions.explanation: want+목적어+to부정사: want Jake to help

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

ⓓ think + yes/no 의문문(if/whether 없이 직접): 올바른 문장.
ⓕ think류 동사 + what → 문두 이동: 올바른 문장.
ⓖ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ 직접의문문이라면 맞지만 문맥상 간접의문문 의도.
ⓔ think류 동사 + what → 문두 이동 필요: What do you think I can do for you?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ Can you guess why they do this?
ⓑ Do you suppose what made her come here?
ⓒ I don't really know when is the class over.
ⓓ He asked me how often she helped him.
ⓔ Let's ask her who the man in the picture is.
ⓕ I'm not sure when he arrived at the station.
ⓖ I didn't know how I dealt with it.
ⓗ Do you think why he's so surprised?
questions.explanation:
ⓑ suppose류(think류) 동사 + what → 의문사 문두 이동: What do you suppose made her come here?
ⓒ 간접의문문은 평서문 어순: I don't really know when the class is over. (when is the class → when the class is)
ⓗ think류 동사 + why → 의문사 문두 이동: Why do you think he's so surprised?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?
(A) I told them to be quiet during the ceremony.
(B) She made him to clean the kitchen.
(C) My coach let me rest before the match.
(D) The teacher encouraged us to try again.
(E) He allowed her entered the building.
(F) They wanted me to pass the exam.
questions.explanation:
옳은 문장 4개: (A), (C), (D), (F)
(A) tell + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(C) 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 원형부정사: 올바른 문장.
(D) encourage + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(F) want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(B) 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: She made him clean the kitchen. (to clean → clean)
(E) allow + 목적어 + to부정사: He allowed her to enter the building. (entered → to enter)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ How can you believe she painted this herself?
ⓑ Why do you think he will arrive late?
ⓒ I don't know when she can help me.
ⓓ Do you imagine what the view looks like?
ⓔ Can you tell me where he went yesterday?
ⓕ Why do you think she would rather stay?
ⓖ Do you suppose what time she will arrive?
ⓗ Where do you know the bus stop is?
questions.explanation:
ⓓ imagine류(think류) + what → 의문사 문두 이동: What do you imagine the view looks like?
ⓖ suppose류(think류) + what time → 의문사 문두 이동: What time do you suppose she will arrive?
ⓗ know는 think류가 아니므로 의문사 문두 이동 불가하지만, "Where do you know the bus stop is?"는 어색하다: Do you know where the bus stop is?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ They wanted me to pass the exam.
ⓑ He told me not to worry about it.
ⓒ Mom always tells me studying hard.
ⓓ Mom allowed me to buy a new jacket.
ⓔ Mike persuaded me joining his club.
ⓕ The doctor advised her not to smoke.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓕ advise + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: Mom always tells me to study hard. (studying → to study)
ⓔ persuade + 목적어 + to부정사: Mike persuaded me to join his club. (joining → to join)

questions.question:
[Part 1] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
My teacher told me __________ harder for the test.
questions.explanation: tell+목적어+to부정사: told me to study

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
She asked him __________ the window.
questions.explanation: ask+목적어+to부정사: asked him to open

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
He __________ me to carry his luggage.
questions.explanation: ask+목적어+to부정사 구문이 가능한 동사는 asked이다. said/talked/spoke/cried는 to부정사 목적격 보어를 취하지 않는다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
My coach __________ me to get more sleep before the game.
questions.explanation: advise+목적어+to부정사: advised me to get. let/make/have는 원형부정사를 취하고, felt는 의미상 부적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
Mom __________ me to set the table before dinner.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
He __________ her to write the report.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
Dad __________ me to learn how to cook.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
She __________ me to take her advice seriously.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
I want Jake __________ me with my science project.
questions.explanation: want+목적어+to부정사: want Jake to help

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
My father __________ me to clean the garage.
questions.explanation: watch는 지각동사로 원형부정사 또는 현재분사를 취한다(watch+목적어+동사원형/-ing). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 모두 고르면?
She __________ them to stay quiet during the exam.
questions.explanation: tell+목적어+to부정사, want+목적어+to부정사가 가능하다. make/let/have는 원형부정사를 취하므로 to부정사와 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:

He __________ me to write a diary in English every day.
questions.explanation: make는 사역동사로 원형부정사를 취한다(make+목적어+동사원형). to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
He __________ his son wash the family car.
questions.explanation: order+목적어+to부정사 구문을 취하므로 원형부정사(wash)와 함께 쓸 수 없다. had/saw/let은 원형부정사를 취하고, helped는 원형부정사와 to부정사 모두 가능하다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
My brother __________ me to do the laundry.
questions.explanation: watch는 지각동사로 원형부정사 또는 현재분사를 취한다. to부정사와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
The coach told him __________ during the match.
questions.explanation: to부정사의 부정은 not to+동사원형 형태이다: told him not to cheat

Ms. Kim (not / arrive / them / told / to / late).

· He wants her ⓑ__________ her shirt.
questions.explanation: ⓐ want+목적어(사물)+과거분사: wants his shirt washed (셔츠가 세탁되기를). ⓑ want+목적어(사람)+to부정사: wants her to wash

options: for them to work for him
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Mr. Brown wanted __________.
questions.explanation: want+목적어+to부정사: wanted them to work for him

options: 그녀는 나에게 늦지 말라고 말했다. → She told me not to late.

그녀는 그에게 모자를 쓰라고 요청했다. → She asked him to wore a hat.
나는 그에게 내일 도서관에 가라고 말할 것이다. → I'll tell him to go to the library tomorrow.
questions.question: 다음 옳은 영작을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ⑤ tell+목적어+to부정사: tell him to go. ① not to 뒤에 동사원형 필요(not to be late). ② ask+목적어+to부정사(to open). ③ tell+목적어+to부정사(to be on time). ④ to 뒤에 동사원형(to wear).

questions.question:

· She wanted me ⓑ(go) there alone.
· Mr. Kim told us ⓒ(study) harder.
questions.explanation: let+목적어+동사원형(tell), want+목적어+to부정사(to go), tell+목적어+to부정사(to study)

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말로 짝지어진 것은?
The doctor __________ me to rest and avoid stress.
told / heard / made / taught / felt / advised / let / wanted / watched

questions.question:

Emily __________ me not to go out alone after dark.
let / wanted / noticed / made / watched / encouraged / felt / advised / told / ordered
questions.explanation: not to+동사원형(to부정사의 부정)을 목적격 보어로 취하는 동사: told, advised, ordered. let/make는 원형부정사, noticed/watched/felt은 지각동사.

(남자가 여자에게 함께 춤추자고 요청하는 상황)
questions.explanation: ask+목적어+to부정사: asks her to dance with him

questions.question:
다음 문장 중 밑줄 친 부분의 문장 요소가 다른 것은?
① He gave <u>me</u> a present.
② We call <u>him</u> Ace.
③ What makes <u>you</u> so excited?
④ I want <u>you</u> to do your best.
⑤ Do you find <u>the movie</u> boring?
questions.explanation: ①의 me는 간접목적어(4형식)이고, ②③④⑤의 밑줄 친 부분은 모두 목적어+목적격 보어(5형식)에서의 목적어이다.

questions.question:
[Part 4] 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
① I want you are happy.
② I ordered them to be quiet.
③ My father let me going camping.
④ Sad movies always make me to cry.
⑤ I helped the old man crossed the street.
questions.explanation: order+목적어+to부정사: ordered them to be quiet. ① want+목적어+to부정사 (are → to be), ③ let+목적어+동사원형 (going → go), ④ make+목적어+동사원형 (to cry → cry), ⑤ help+목적어+동사원형/to부정사 (crossed → cross/to cross)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 모두 고르면?

② The teacher advised me to study harder.
③ Do you want me to bring it to the party?
④ I would like you going with me.
⑤ He helped her to carry the boxes.
questions.explanation: ② advise+목적어+to부정사, ③ want+목적어+to부정사, ⑤ help+목적어+to부정사. ① allow+목적어+to부정사 (leave → to leave), ④ would like+목적어+to부정사 (going → to go)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
① I expect her to succeeded.
② I told Jane cleaning the room.
③ He advised her go to Jeju.
④ She asked me doing my homework.
⑤ My mom wants me to eat breakfast.
questions.explanation: want+목적어+to부정사: wants me to eat. ① to+동사원형 (succeeded → succeed), ② tell+목적어+to부정사 (cleaning → to clean), ③ advise+목적어+to부정사 (go → to go), ④ ask+목적어+to부정사 (doing → to do)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
① I want you to weed this garden.
② Did he ask you to do more work?
③ Jane stopped eating junk food.
④ I heard you sing in a beautiful voice.
⑤ She told me finish the essay today.
questions.explanation: tell+목적어+to부정사: told me to finish. finish 앞에 to가 빠져 어색하다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
① I made myself calm.
② Many things made him sadly.
③ I expected him buy me flowers.
④ Mom wants me read a lot of books.
⑤ My mom told me cleaning my room.
questions.explanation: make+목적어+형용사(목적격보어): made myself calm. ② 형용사 보어 필요 (sadly → sad), ③ expect+목적어+to부정사 (buy → to buy), ④ want+목적어+to부정사 (read → to read), ⑤ tell+목적어+to부정사 (cleaning → to clean)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
① My teacher advised me to do my homework.
② I advised her playing with them.
③ They encouraged me study English.
④ She wants that I go with her.
⑤ He allowed me entered the building.
questions.explanation: advise+목적어+to부정사: advised me to do. ② playing → to play, ③ study → to study, ④ want+목적어+to부정사 (that절 불가), ⑤ allow+목적어+to부정사 (entered → to enter)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
① Eric told you to be on time.
② He wants me not to tell a lie.
③ My mom asked me bring some water.
④ I help my dad wash his car.
⑤ Sumi tells me to call her very soon.
questions.explanation: ask+목적어+to부정사: asked me to bring. bring 앞에 to가 빠져 어색하다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
① I asked them not to play at night.
② She asked the students their names.
③ Would you like her to order food?
④ Let me introduce you to our team.
⑤ She forced herself be polite to them.
questions.explanation: force+목적어+to부정사: forced herself to be. be 앞에 to가 빠져 어색하다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
① The book made me want to travel more.
② My parents let me join the art club.
③ My teacher asked me to work harder.
④ Mom told me to tidy my room.
⑤ I advise him not tell a lie.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
① Are we allowed staying here?
② I didn't expect him go with us.
③ I don't want you will hurt yourself.

다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ She told her son to clean his room.
ⓑ The girl made the dog to stop barking.
ⓒ My father forced me to finish my report.
ⓓ The coach wanted the player to run faster.
ⓔ She advised her sister to stop eating late.
ⓕ His boots enable him to move quietly.
questions.explanation:
어색한 문장은 ⓑ 하나뿐이다.
ⓑ 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: The girl made the dog stop barking. (to stop → stop)
나머지 문장은 모두 어법상 올바르다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ He wants her to not leave now. (= He wants her not to leave now.)
ⓑ Who told you to come to the recital?
ⓒ My teacher asked me to retake the test.
ⓓ They didn't want me to be nervous.
ⓔ My mother wants that I get up at 7.
questions.explanation:
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ ask + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ want + 목적어 + to부정사(부정): 올바른 문장.
ⓐ want + 목적어 + not to부정사: He wants her not to leave now. (to not은 비표준)
ⓔ want + 목적어 + to부정사: My mother wants me to get up at 7. (wants that I → wants me to)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ They wanted me to pass the test.
ⓑ He told me not to worry about that.
ⓒ Mom always tells me studying hard.
ⓓ Mom allowed me to buy a new bag.
ⓔ Mike persuaded me to join his art club.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓔ persuade + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: Mom always tells me to study hard. (studying → to study)

options: He wanted to be a teacher.
He wanted I be a teacher.
He wanted I to be a teacher.
He wanted me to be a teacher.
He wanted me be a teacher.
questions.question:
[Part 8] 다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
나는 그가 선생님이 되기를 원하셨다.
questions.explanation:
want + 목적어(목적격) + to부정사 구문을 사용한다.
주어가 원하는 대상이 "나"이므로 목적격 me를 사용: He wanted me to be a teacher.
② I be → 목적격 me 필요 + to 필요
③ I to be → 목적격 me 필요
⑤ me be → to 필요

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ I want to know who broke the vase.
ⓑ Do you think who will be her new partner?
ⓒ I'm wondering whether he is at home.
ⓓ What do you believe happened to her?
ⓔ I'm curious about what did she do last summer.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 간접의문문 어순(주어+동사): 올바른 문장.
ⓒ whether + 주어 + 동사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ think/believe류 동사는 의문사를 문두로 이동: What do you believe happened to her? 올바른 문장.
ⓑ think류 동사 + 의문사 → 의문사를 문두로: Who do you think will be her new partner?
ⓔ 간접의문문은 평서문 어순: what she did last summer (did she do → she did)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ She doesn't know where he is from.
ⓑ I don't understand why they are angry.
ⓒ I don't know if John and Tom are coming.
ⓓ When do you think they will finish?
ⓔ Nobody knows when the accident did happened.
questions.explanation:
ⓔ 조동사 did + 과거형 happened는 이중 과거로 어색하다: Nobody knows when the accident happened. (did happened → happened)
ⓐ 전치사로 끝나는 간접의문문: 엄격한 문법에서는 어색할 수 있다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은? (정답 2개)
① What movie do you know she wants to see?
② The student knows how it is hard to be a nurse.
③ I wonder whether you'd like to come to the party.
④ I'd like to know how many stars we can see at night.
⑤ Do you think which one is smarter, a cat or a dog?
questions.explanation:
③ wonder + whether절(간접의문문): 올바른 문장.
④ how many + 명사 + 주어 + 동사(간접의문문 어순): 올바른 문장.
① know는 think류가 아니므로 의문사 문두 이동 불가: Do you know what movie she wants to see?
② how + 형용사 + it is: The student knows how hard it is to be a nurse.
⑤ think류 동사 + which → 문두 이동: Which one do you think is smarter?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ I don't know that she will attend the event or not.
ⓑ Can you tell me when your birthday is?
ⓒ She asks me when we will meet.
ⓓ Do you know who did drew this picture?
ⓔ I don't know who is telling the truth.
ⓕ Do you think why she smiled?
questions.explanation:
ⓐ "~인지 아닌지"는 whether/if 사용: I don't know whether she will attend the event or not. (that → whether/if)
ⓓ 조동사 did + 과거형 drew는 이중 과거: Do you know who drew this picture? (did drew → drew)
ⓕ think류 동사 + why → 의문사 문두 이동: Why do you think she smiled? (Do you think why → Why do you think)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ I want to know where she studies.
ⓑ Do you know what song she wants to sing?
ⓒ What kind of job do I want to have?
ⓓ Do you think I should take a break?
ⓔ Do you think what I can do for you?
ⓕ What do you think you want to eat?
ⓖ The woman wants to know how much it is.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ think + yes/no 의문문(if/whether 없이 직접): 올바른 문장.
ⓕ think류 동사 + what → 문두 이동: 올바른 문장.
ⓖ 간접의문문 어순: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ 직접의문문이라면 맞지만 문맥상 간접의문문 의도.
ⓔ think류 동사 + what → 문두 이동 필요: What do you think I can do for you?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ Can you guess why they do this?
ⓑ Do you suppose what made her come here?
ⓒ I don't really know when is the class over.
ⓓ He asked me how often she helped him.
ⓔ Let's ask her who the man in the picture is.
ⓕ I'm not sure when he arrived at the station.
ⓖ I didn't know how I dealt with it.
ⓗ Do you think why he's so surprised?
questions.explanation:
ⓑ suppose류(think류) 동사 + what → 의문사 문두 이동: What do you suppose made her come here?
ⓒ 간접의문문은 평서문 어순: I don't really know when the class is over. (when is the class → when the class is)
ⓗ think류 동사 + why → 의문사 문두 이동: Why do you think he's so surprised?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?
(A) I told them to be quiet during the ceremony.
(B) She made him to clean the kitchen.
(C) My coach let me rest before the match.
(D) The teacher encouraged us to try again.
(E) He allowed her entered the building.
(F) They wanted me to pass the exam.
questions.explanation:
옳은 문장 4개: (A), (C), (D), (F)
(A) tell + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(C) 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 원형부정사: 올바른 문장.
(D) encourage + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(F) want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
(B) 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사: She made him clean the kitchen. (to clean → clean)
(E) allow + 목적어 + to부정사: He allowed her to enter the building. (entered → to enter)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
ⓐ How can you believe she painted this herself?
ⓑ Why do you think he will arrive late?
ⓒ I don't know when she can help me.
ⓓ Do you imagine what the view looks like?
ⓔ Can you tell me where he went yesterday?
ⓕ Why do you think she would rather stay?
ⓖ Do you suppose what time she will arrive?
ⓗ Where do you know the bus stop is?
questions.explanation:
ⓓ imagine류(think류) + what → 의문사 문두 이동: What do you imagine the view looks like?
ⓖ suppose류(think류) + what time → 의문사 문두 이동: What time do you suppose she will arrive?
ⓗ know는 think류가 아니므로 의문사 문두 이동 불가하지만, "Where do you know the bus stop is?"는 어색하다: Do you know where the bus stop is?

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ They wanted me to pass the exam.
ⓑ He told me not to worry about it.
ⓒ Mom always tells me studying hard.
ⓓ Mom allowed me to buy a new jacket.
ⓔ Mike persuaded me joining his club.
ⓕ The doctor advised her not to smoke.
questions.explanation:
ⓐ want + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓑ tell + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓓ allow + 목적어 + to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓕ advise + 목적어 + not to부정사: 올바른 문장.
ⓒ tell + 목적어 + to부정사: Mom always tells me to study hard. (studying → to study)
ⓔ persuade + 목적어 + to부정사: Mike persuaded me to join his club. (joining → to join)

questions.question:
[Part 1] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Can you tell me __________ the next train leaves?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문에서 시간을 묻는 의문사 when이 적절

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

Do you know __________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 의문사+주어+동사 어순 → when does the store close는 직접의문문 어순

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 말을 모두 고르면?

I'm not sure __________ she will attend the meeting.
ⓐ if  ⓑ that  ⓒ because  ⓓ whether  ⓔ when
questions.explanation: yes/no 의문문의 간접의문문에는 if 또는 whether를 사용

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

How do you __________ she became so successful?
questions.explanation: 의문사가 문두에 나오려면 think류 동사(think, suppose, believe, imagine)가 필요하다. know는 해당되지 않는다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

I wonder __________ he missed the bus this morning.
questions.explanation: 버스를 놓친 이유를 궁금해하므로 why가 적절

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Please tell me __________ I can find the nearest pharmacy.
questions.explanation: 장소를 묻는 간접의문문이므로 where가 적절

options: how long it takes to get there
what kind of music she likes
why does he always come late
if the restaurant is open on Sundays
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

Can you tell me __________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 의문사+주어+동사 어순 → why does he는 직접의문문 어순

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Do you know __________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 의문사+주어+동사 어순 → what time the concert starts만 올바른 어순

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

A: I need to submit my assignment but I don't know __________.
B: The deadline is this Friday at noon.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 의문사+주어+동사 어순 → when the deadline is

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

A: I'm curious about __________.
B: It's the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 의문사+주어+동사 어순 → where this famous tower is만 올바른 어순

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

I wonder __________ last weekend.
questions.explanation: last weekend(과거)이므로 과거시제 + 간접의문문 어순 → where Kevin went

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 말을 모두 고르면?

Do you know __________?
ⓐ who is the new science teacher
ⓑ how many people live in this city
ⓒ when does he finish work
ⓓ where she studied abroad
ⓔ what is the girl's hobby
questions.explanation: 간접의문문 어순(의문사+주어+동사)에 맞는 것은 ⓑ와 ⓓ

options: how many hours she sleeps a day
why did he change his mind
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

Do you know __________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 의문사+주어+동사 어순 → why did he는 직접의문문 어순

options: sending an email to her last night
what she was wearing at the event
how I got to the hotel
the man wearing a blue jacket
where did I put my passport
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

I don't remember __________.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문 어순 → where did I는 직접의문문 어순

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?

Could you tell me __________?
ⓐ what the problem is
ⓑ who owns this building
ⓒ if the story is true
ⓓ what does she look like
ⓔ how long have you been here
questions.explanation: ⓓ와 ⓔ는 직접의문문 어순 → 간접의문문에 부적절

options: I'm not sure when will dinner be ready.
I'm not sure if dinner will be ready.
I'm not sure where dinner will be ready.
I'm not sure if will dinner be ready.
I'm not sure when dinner will be ready.
questions.question:
[Part 2] 다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

저녁 식사가 언제 준비될지 모르겠어요.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문 어순(의문사+주어+동사): when dinner will be ready

options: I wonder what time are we going to leave.
I wonder we are going to leave what time.
I wonder what time we are going to leave.
I wonder what we are going to leave time.
I wonder are we going to leave what time.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

우리가 몇 시에 출발할 예정인지 궁금해.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문 어순: what time we are going to leave

options: Do you know who take the picture?
Do you know who took the picture?
Who took the picture do you know?
Do you know who was taking the picture?
Who do you know took the picture?
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

너는 누가 그 사진을 찍었는지 아니?
questions.explanation: who가 주어인 간접의문문 → 어순 변화 없음, 과거시제 took

options: How old do you know her brother is?
How old do you know is her brother?
Do you know how old her brother is?
Do you know how old is her brother?
Do you know is her brother how old?
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

너는 그녀의 남동생이 몇 살인지 아니?
questions.explanation: know는 think류가 아니므로 의문사가 절 안에 남음: how old her brother is

options: I don't know if is there a subway station nearby.
I don't know if there is a subway station nearby.
I don't know there a is subway station nearby.
I don't know is there a subway station nearby.
I don't know how there is a subway station nearby.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

이 근처에 지하철역이 있는지 모르겠어.
questions.explanation: yes/no 의문문의 간접의문문: if + 주어 + 동사 어순

questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영작할 때 4번째로 오는 단어는?

그녀가 왜 그 경기를 포기했다고 생각하니?
→ Why do you think she gave up the game?
questions.explanation: think류 동사 → 의문사(Why)가 문두로 이동하여 Why do you think she gave up the game?

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 괄호 안의 단어들을 바르게 배열할 때, 세 번째로 오는 단어는?

그들이 그 프로젝트를 좋아하는지 너는 알고 있니?
→ Do you (know / if / like / they / the) project?
questions.explanation: Do you know if they like the project? → 괄호 안 배열: know(1) if(2) they(3) like(4) the(5) → 세 번째 they

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

We may have different opinions about <u>무엇이 진정한 행복을 만드는지</u>.
questions.explanation: what이 주어 → 어순 변화 없이 what makes true happiness (3인칭 단수 -s)

options: Do you know how can we reduce waste?
Do you know how we can reduce waste?
Do you know the way we can reduce waste?
Do you know the way that we can reduce waste?
Do you know the way in which we can reduce waste?
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 질문 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

Q: __________?
A: You can reduce waste by using reusable bags when you go shopping.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문 어순 → how can we는 직접의문문 어순, how we can이 올바름

options: Do you think why these changes are happening so fast?
Do you think why are happening these changes so fast?
Do you think why are these changes happening so fast?
Why do you think these changes are happening so fast?
Why do you think are these changes happening so fast?
questions.question:
다음 문장에서 어법상 오류를 찾아 고친 것으로 옳은 것은?

Do you think why these changes are happening so fast?
questions.explanation: think류 동사 → 의문사(Why)가 문두로 이동

options: I'd like to know when she arrives at the airport.
I'd like to know when she arrived at the airport.
I'd like to know when arrived she at the airport.
I'd like to know when she has arrived at the airport.
I'd like to know when did she arrive at the airport.
questions.question:
[Part 3] 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?

· I'd like to know.
· When did she arrive at the airport?
questions.explanation: did arrive → arrived로 변환하고 간접의문문 어순 적용

options: What can you tell me he ordered?
What can you tell me he orders?
Can you tell me what he orders?
Can you tell me what he ordered?
Can you tell me what did he order?

[Part 7] 다음 대화의 빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것은?

A: Where is Sujin?
B: She __________ to the convenience store. She'll be back soon.
questions.explanation: 여기 없음 + 곧 돌아옴 → has gone

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것은?

A: Do you want to watch this movie?
B: No thanks. I __________ it already. Let's watch something else.
questions.explanation: already → 현재완료(완료)

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것은?

A: Is your mom home?
B: No. She __________ to the supermarket. She bought some vegetables for us.
questions.explanation: 야채를 사왔음 → 갔다 돌아옴 → has been

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것은?

A: You look tired. What happened?
B: I __________ all night to finish my assignment.
questions.explanation: 결과(피곤해 보임) → 현재완료

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 가장 알맞은 것은?

A: Can I speak to Jake, please?
B: I'm sorry, but he __________ out. He'll be back after dinner.
questions.explanation: 여기 없음(외출 중) → has gone

options: She has been to New York twice.
He has lost his wallet. He can't pay.
Have you already packed your bag?
I have never tried rock climbing before.
questions.question:
[Part 8] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?

<보기> I <u>have just finished</u> my homework. (완료)
questions.explanation: 보기=완료(just), ④=완료(already)

options: She has just arrived at the station.
I have studied Japanese for 5 years.
I have seen a rainbow before.
How long have you stayed here?
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?

<보기> <u>Have you ever ridden</u> a horse? (경험)
questions.explanation: 보기=경험(ever), ③=경험(before)

options: Have you ever tried Thai food?
I have worked here since March.
He has already finished his homework.
My friend has gone to Canada. He's not here.
She has read "Harry Potter" three times.
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?

<보기> She <u>has lost</u> her passport. She can't travel. (결과)
questions.explanation: 보기=결과, ④=결과(가고 없음)

options: I have once lived in London.
I have never met any movie stars.
Have you ever been to Sydney?
I have read the novel twice.
She has lived in Seoul since she was eight.
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?

<보기> I <u>have known</u> him for ten years. (계속)
questions.explanation: 보기=계속(for), ⑤=계속(since)

options: Have you heard about the new café?
She has been to Jejudo three times.
She hasn't seen a koala before.
She has ridden a horse once.
She has gone to Fiji with her family.
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 다른 것은?

<보기> She <u>has met</u> him twice. (경험)
questions.explanation: ①②③④=경험, ⑤=결과(가고 없음)

questions.answer: ③
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

___ is my best friend. We go to the same school.
questions.explanation: 빈칸은 문장의 주어 자리입니다. 주어 자리에는 명사(사람 이름)가 와야 합니다. Lucy(사람 이름)만이 주어로 쓸 수 있습니다.

questions.answer: ②
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 be동사가 순서대로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

I ___ a student. My dog ___ very cute. My parents ___ teachers.
questions.explanation: I → am, My dog(단수) → is, My parents(복수) → are 를 사용합니다.

questions.answer: ⑤
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 be동사로 알맞지 않은 것은?

___ from Korea.
questions.explanation: You의 be동사는 are입니다. 'You is'는 문법적으로 틀린 표현입니다.

questions.answer: ②
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

• ___ you a new student here?
• ___ your brother good at soccer?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장은 'Are you ~?'가 되어야 하므로 Are가 맞고, 두 번째는 'your brother(3인칭 단수)'이므로 Is가 맞습니다. 두 문장 모두에 공통으로 들어갈 수 있는 것은 Is입니다. (첫 문장은 의문문이므로 Is you가 아닌 Are you가 맞지만, 선택지를 보면 두 빈칸에 동일한 단어가 들어갑니다. 두 번째 문장 기준 Is가 정답입니다.)

questions.answer: ④
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

A: Was she at the library yesterday?
B: ___. She was at home.
questions.explanation: 과거 be동사(Was)로 묻는 질문에 부정으로 답할 때는 'No, she wasn't.'를 사용합니다. B의 말에서 집에 있었다고 했으므로 도서관에는 없었다는 부정 답변이 맞습니다.

questions.answer: ②
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

A: Are you and Jake on the same team?
B: ___
questions.explanation: 'you and Jake(너와 Jake)'를 주어로 묻는 질문에는 'we'로 받아 'Yes, we are.' 또는 'No, we aren't.'로 답해야 합니다.

questions.answer: ③
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 차례대로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?

My name (A)___ Jiwon. I (B)___ from Busan.
questions.explanation: My name은 3인칭 단수이므로 is, I는 1인칭 단수이므로 am을 씁니다.

questions.answer: ①
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

Harry and I ___ in the same class last year, but now we ___ in different classes.
questions.explanation: 'Harry and I(복수, 과거)'이므로 were, '지금(현재, 복수)'은 are를 사용합니다.

questions.answer: ③
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

The books on the desk ___ mine. The pencil case ___ my sister's.
questions.explanation: 'The books(복수)' → are, 'The pencil case(단수)' → is를 사용합니다.

questions.answer: ①
questions.question:
[빈칸 채우기] 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 차례대로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?

Hi! I (A)___ Sora. My hobby (B)___ drawing. My friends (C)___ also interested in art.
questions.explanation: I → am, My hobby(단수) → is, My friends(복수) → are를 사용합니다.

questions.answer: ②
options: ① She not is a famous singer.
② She is not a famous singer.
③ She does not a famous singer.
④ Is not she a famous singer.
⑤ She is a not famous singer.
questions.question:
[영작 선택] 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

그녀는 유명한 가수가 아니다.
questions.explanation: be동사의 부정문은 'be동사 + not' 형태입니다. 'She is not a famous singer.'가 올바른 표현입니다.

questions.answer: ①
options: ① Were they in the same class last year?
② Was they in the same class last year?
③ Are they in the same class last year?
④ They were in the same class last year?
⑤ Did they in the same class last year?
questions.question:
[영작 선택] 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

그들은 작년에 같은 반이었니?
questions.explanation: 과거 의문문이고 주어가 they(복수)이므로 'Were they ~?'가 올바른 표현입니다.

questions.answer: ③
options: ① I amn't shy. I am outgoing.
② I not am shy. I am outgoing.
③ I'm not shy. I'm outgoing.
④ I isn't shy. I am outgoing.
⑤ I aren't shy. I'm outgoing.
questions.question:
[영작 선택] 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

나는 수줍음이 많지 않다. 나는 외향적이다.
questions.explanation: 'I am not'의 줄임말은 'I'm not'입니다. 'amn't'는 올바른 영어 표현이 아닙니다.

questions.answer: ②
options: ① Tom and I is in the classroom now.
② Tom and I are in the classroom now.
③ Tom and me are in the classroom now.
④ Tom and I am in the classroom now.
⑤ Tom and I were in the classroom now.
questions.question:
[영작 선택] 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

 Tom과 나는 지금 교실에 있다.
questions.explanation: 'Tom and I'는 복수 주어이므로 are를 사용합니다. 또한 주어 자리에는 'me'가 아닌 'I'를 씁니다.

questions.answer: ①
options: ① Is this your new bag?
② Are this your new bag?
③ This is your new bag?
④ Does this your new bag?
⑤ Is your new bag this?
questions.question:
[영작 선택] 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

이것이 네 새 가방이니?
questions.explanation: be동사 의문문은 'be동사 + 주어'의 어순입니다. this는 단수이므로 Is를 사용하여 'Is this your new bag?'이 올바른 표현입니다.

questions.answer: ②
options: ② The cat is under the table.
④ He is kind and friendly.
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 밑줄 친 be동사의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① She is a doctor.
② The cat is under the table.
③ My brother is tall.
④ He is kind and friendly.
⑤ They are students.
questions.explanation: ②의 is는 '위치'를 나타내는 be동사이고, 나머지 ①③④⑤는 주어의 정체나 상태(직업, 모습, 성격)를 설명하는 be동사입니다.

questions.answer: ②
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나는?

① I'm happy today.
② She's in the library.
③ We're good friends.
④ He's a soccer player.
⑤ They're very smart.
questions.explanation: ②의 be동사는 '위치(장소)'를 나타내고, 나머지는 모두 주어의 상태, 성격, 신분을 설명합니다.

questions.answer: ②
options: ③ The dog ___ behind the sofa.
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① My sister ___ a nurse.
② Jack and Mia ___ twins.
③ The dog ___ behind the sofa.
④ Kevin ___ very funny.
⑤ His name ___ David.
questions.explanation: ②의 주어 'Jack and Mia'는 복수이므로 are를 써야 하고, 나머지 ①③④⑤는 모두 3인칭 단수 주어로 is를 씁니다.

questions.answer: ④
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 축약형이 나머지와 다른 방식으로 쓰인 것은?

① That's a good idea.
② She's my English teacher.
③ It's a lovely day.
④ Tom's bag is heavy.
⑤ He's from Canada.
questions.explanation: ④의 Tom's는 소유격('s)이고, 나머지 ①②③⑤의 's는 be동사(is)의 축약형입니다.

questions.answer: ④
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① Emily ___
② The weather ___
③ My favorite subject ___
④ My classmates ___
⑤ The movie ___
questions.explanation: 'My classmates'는 복수 명사이므로 are를 쓰고, 나머지 ①②③⑤는 모두 단수 주어이므로 is를 씁니다.

questions.answer: ⑤
options: ① He was sick last week.
② They were on a trip yesterday.
③ She was my classmate last year.
④ We were late for school this morning.
⑤ The kids are in the park now.
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 현재 시제와 과거 시제가 혼용된 상황에서 밑줄 친 be동사의 형태가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① He was sick last week.
② They were on a trip yesterday.
③ She was my classmate last year.
④ We were late for school this morning.
⑤ The kids are in the park now.
questions.explanation: ⑤의 are는 현재형이고, 나머지 ①②③④는 모두 과거형(was/were)입니다.

questions.answer: ③
options: ① Are you ready for the test?
② Is he a baseball player?
③ They are in the gym.
④ She is a kind person.
⑤ My cat is very playful.
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지와 다른 하나는?

① Are you ready for the test?
② Is he a baseball player?
③ They are in the gym.
④ She is a kind person.
⑤ My cat is very playful.
questions.explanation: ③의 be동사는 '위치'를 나타내고, 나머지는 주어의 상태나 신분을 설명하는 be동사입니다.

questions.answer: ④
options: ① Jenny's happy about the news.
④ Minho's notebook is on the desk.
⑤ She's really good at math.
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 밑줄 친 's의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① Jenny's happy about the news.
② It's cold outside today.
③ Mike's in his room.
④ Minho's notebook is on the desk.
⑤ She's really good at math.
questions.explanation: ④의 's는 소유격을 나타내고, 나머지 ①②③⑤의 's는 be동사 is의 축약형입니다.

questions.answer: ④
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 주어에 따른 be동사의 연결이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① The children → are
② My teacher → is
③ The flowers → are
④ His pants → is
⑤ The puppies → are
questions.explanation: 'pants'는 항상 복수 취급하므로 are를 써야 합니다. 'His pants → are'가 올바릅니다.

questions.answer: ⑤
options: ① I was tired after the game.
② She was at the store an hour ago.
③ The students were excited about the trip.
④ My dog was sick last month.
⑤ We was late for the concert.
questions.question:
[용법 구별] 다음 중 be동사의 과거형 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① I was tired after the game.
② She was at the store an hour ago.
③ The students were excited about the trip.
④ My dog was sick last month.
⑤ We was late for the concert.
questions.explanation: 'We'는 복수이므로 was가 아닌 were를 써야 합니다. ⑤는 어법상 틀린 문장입니다.

questions.answer: ④
options: ① He am a very good cook.
② She are my best friend.
③ We is in the same club.
④ They are from the same city.
⑤ I is not hungry right now.
questions.question:
[어법 판단] 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?

① He am a very good cook.
② She are my best friend.
③ We is in the same club.
④ They are from the same city.
⑤ I is not hungry right now.
questions.explanation: ④ 'They are from the same city.'는 복수 주어 They에 are를 사용하여 어법상 옳습니다. 나머지는 주어와 be동사가 일치하지 않습니다.

questions.answer: ③
options: ① My friends are very kind to me.
② Is your father a dentist?
③ She amn't interested in sports.
⑤ He isn't at school today.
questions.question:
[어법 판단] 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?

① My friends are very kind to me.
② Is your father a dentist?
③ She amn't interested in sports.
④ We aren't ready yet.
⑤ He isn't at school today.
questions.explanation: 'amn't'는 올바른 영어 표현이 아닙니다. 'I am not'의 줄임말은 'I'm not'이며, she의 경우 'She isn't' 또는 'She's not'을 써야 합니다.

questions.answer: ③
questions.question:
[어법 판단] 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 모두 고르면?

ⓐ My brother and sister is at home.
ⓑ Are you interested in music?
ⓒ The weather was nice yesterday.
ⓓ He were a famous scientist.
ⓔ I am not good at cooking.
questions.explanation: ⓑ(Are you ~?), ⓒ(was는 단수 과거로 올바름), ⓔ(I am not은 올바름)이 맞습니다. ⓐ는 복수이므로 are, ⓓ는 He 단수이므로 was를 써야 합니다.

questions.answer: ⑤
options: ① The boys were excited about the game.
② Was she at the party last night?
③ I was not happy with the result.
④ Were you and Tom classmates in elementary school?
⑤ My parents was very busy last weekend.
questions.question:
[어법 판단] 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?

① The boys were excited about the game.
② Was she at the party last night?
③ I was not happy with the result.
④ Were you and Tom classmates in elementary school?
⑤ My parents was very busy last weekend.
questions.explanation: 'My parents'는 복수이므로 was가 아닌 were를 써야 합니다.

questions.answer: ②
questions.question:
[어법 판단] 다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?

Hello! ⓐI am Jisu. ⓑMy school are near my house. ⓒMy homeroom teacher is Mr. Kim. ⓓHe are tall and friendly. ⓔI am really happy at my new school.
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'My school(단수)'은 is를 써야 하므로 'My school is ~'가 맞습니다. ⓓ 'He(단수)'는 is를 써야 하므로 'He is ~'가 맞습니다.

questions.answer: ③
questions.question:
[어법 판단] 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?

ⓐ She is not at home right now.
ⓑ Are he your brother?
ⓒ They were students at that time.
ⓓ I amn't late for class.
ⓔ We are on the same soccer team.
questions.explanation: ⓐ(She is not → 올바름), ⓒ(They were → 올바름), ⓔ(We are → 올바름)이 어법상 맞습니다. ⓑ는 'Is he ~?'가 맞고, ⓓ는 'I'm not late ~'가 맞습니다. 총 3개가 올바릅니다.

questions.answer: ③
options: ① They aren't in the gym.
② Is she a famous actress?
③ I amn't a middle school student.
⑤ We aren't good at English.

options: The geographical characteristics of Jeju-do that attract dolphins

questions.question:
[지문]
You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a great way to learn about social issues and make the world better. Are you interested? Then, read Inho's blog below.

JAN 5
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

[지문]
다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글에서 십대 청소년이 사회적·환경적 문제(돌고래 보호)에 참여하기 위해 NGO에 가입하는 과정을 보여줌으로써, 청소년의 사회 참여의 중요성을 강조하고 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. ⓐThe latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. ⓑI really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

ⓒToday, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. ⓓIn fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. ⓔAfter 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is no longer their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.

[지문]
주어진 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 글의 흐름에 가장 관계 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is no longer their home.'는 문맥상 모순이다. 돌고래가 바다로 돌아갔으므로 '바다가 더 이상 그들의 집이 아니다'는 표현은 맞지 않으며, '바다가 그들의 진정한 집이 되었다'는 의미여야 한다.

questions.explanation: 대화에서 Ms. Lee가 Chris에게 '곧 많은 친구를 사귀기를 바란다'고 말했으므로, 다음에는 새로운 친구를 사귀기 위한 방법에 대한 조언이 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.

options: Comparison and Contrast: Comparing two different dolphin species found in Jeju-do
Problem and Solution: Identifying the threat to dolphins and taking action to join an organization
Cause and Effect: Explaining how internet usage leads to environmental pollution
Timeline Listing: Listing the history of the dolphin protection organization
Definition and Example: Defining what an NGO is and listing various types of NGOs
questions.question:
[지문]
JAN 5
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

[지문]
다음 글의 전개 방식으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글은 돌고래의 멸종 위기라는 문제를 제시한 후, 이 문제를 해결하기 위해 NGO 단체에 가입하는 방법을 제시하는 문제-해결 구조로 전개된다.

options: To warn him that the test will be very difficult.
To agree with him that he needs more practice.
To judge his math ability based on his grades.
To relieve his anxiety and give him confidence.
To predict that he will get a perfect score.
questions.question:
[지문]
A: I have a math test tomorrow.
B: Good luck, Minsu. I hope you do well on it.
A: Thanks, but I'm a little nervous. I don't think I'm well prepared.
B: Don't worry. You'll do fine.

[지문]
다음 글의 밑줄 친 "You'll do fine."의 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: A가 불안감을 표현했을 때, B가 'Don't worry. You'll do fine.'이라고 말하는 것은 A의 불안감을 덜어주고 자신감을 주기 위한 의도이다.

options: Stay safe and healthy in the wild!
Live freely and happily ever after!
Come back to the aquarium anytime!
Beware of the fishing nets and plastics!
Have a safe journey to your new home!
questions.question:
[지문]
This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "____________________" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.

[지문]
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 돌고래를 바다로 돌려보내며 안녕을 고하는 상황이므로 '언제든 수족관에 돌아와'라는 표현은 문맥상 적절하지 않다. 다른 선택지들은 모두 돌고래의 안전과 행복을 바라는 내용으로 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르시오.

① The teacher made the students curious about the new topic.
② The movie made the audience silent during the final scene.
③ His encouraging words made the team confident before the match.
④ The noisy machine made the room uncomfortable for everyone.
⑤ The company made a new service for the workers.
questions.explanation: ①~④는 'make + 목적어 + 형용사' 구조로 '~을 ~하게 만들다'는 의미이다. 반면 ⑤의 'make a new service'는 '새로운 서비스를 만들다'는 뜻으로, 'make + 목적어 + 명사' 구조로 쓰임이 다르다.

questions.question:
[지문]
You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a great way (A) [to learn / learning] about social issues and make the world better. Are you (B) [interesting / interested]? Then, (C) [read / reading] Inho's blog below.

[지문]
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 적절한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'way to learn'은 '배우는 방법'으로 to부정사가 맞다. (B) 'be interested in'은 '~에 관심이 있다'는 의미로 interested가 맞다. (C) 명령문이므로 동사원형 'read'가 맞다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. For this, we do various activities. (A) 예를 들어, 우리는 제로 웨이스트 챌린지와 나무 심기 행사를 엽니다. Interested? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것 (어형 변화 없음)
- and / hold / we / example, / zero-waste / events / challenges / For / planting / tree

[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. For this, we do various activities. (A) 예를 들어, 우리는 제로 웨이스트 챌린지와 나무 심기 행사를 엽니다. Interested? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

위 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 5번째에 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 주어진 단어를 배열하면 'For example, we hold zero-waste challenges and tree planting events'가 되며, 5번째 단어는 'zero-waste'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에 대한 아래 <보기>의 설명에서 적절한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. ⓐ There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. ⓑThe ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now ⓒI cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. ⓓ After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" ⓔI shouted and waved goodbye to them.

<보기>
㉠ all과 the가 사용될때는 the + all의 어순이므로 틀린 문장이다.
㉡ made는 뒤에 목적어 us와 목적보어 emotional이 오는 사역동사 + 목적어 + 형용사 구조가 문법적으로 적절하다.
㉢ anymore는 부정문에서 '더 이상'이라는 의미로 쓰이는 부사이며, cannot과 함께 쓰여 의미상 자연스럽다.
㉣ all the sea는 '바다 전체'라는 복수 개념을 나타내므로 뒤에 오는 동사는 단수 동사 is가 아니라 are로 고쳐야 한다.
㉤ shouted and waved는 and가 두 동작을 병렬로 연결하는 등위접속사이므로 두 동사 모두 과거형을 쓰는 것이 맞다. 또한 작별 인사를 보낸 대상을 나타낼 때는 to를 삭제해야 한다.
questions.explanation: ㉡과 ㉢이 적절한 설명이다. ㉡은 'make + 목적어 + 형용사'는 사역동사의 올바른 구조이다. ㉢은 anymore가 부정문에서 '더 이상'의 의미로 쓰이며 cannot과의 조합이 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
어법상 옳지 않은 것을 모두 고르시오.

① Jina woke up early to catch the first bus.
② She didn't went to the concert yesterday.
③ Minho added a little water to the mixture.
④ He hopes he can make the right decision for his team.
⑤ The loud noise made the children to feel uncomfortable.
questions.explanation: ②번: 'didn't went'는 틀렸다. 과거시제에서는 'didn't go'로 써야 한다. ⑤번: 'make + 목적어 + 동사원형' 구조인데 'to feel'로 to부정사를 썼으므로 'to'를 삭제해야 한다. 올바른 형태는 'The loud noise made the children feel uncomfortable.'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

JAN 5

Realizing the dolphins' ___(A)___ situation, the writer joined an NGO and participated in environmental ___(B)___ activities to help them.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 단어를 문맥상 아래의 단어로 바꿔 쓴다고 할 때, 적절하지 않은 것은?

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does ① various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

options: How long had Halla and Olle been kept in aquarium?

questions.question:
다음 글을 바탕으로 인터뷰를 진행한다고 할 때, 글의 내용만으로는 답변을 들을 수 없는 질문은?

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

questions.explanation: 글에서 돌고래들이 배워야 할 기술이 필요하다고만 언급되었을 뿐, 구체적으로 어떤 기술들을 배웠는지는 명시되어 있지 않다. 나머지 질문들은 모두 글의 내용에서 답변을 찾을 수 있다.

options: Because they were injured and needed physical therapy.
Because they had lost their natural instincts during their life in captivity.
Because the NGO wanted to show their training process to the public.
Because they needed to learn how to avoid plastic waste specifically.
Because the aquarium laws require training before any animal transfer.
questions.question:
다음 글의 내용으로 미루어 볼 때, Halla와 Olle가 방류 전 훈련을 받아야 했던 가장 근본적인 이유는?

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" <보기>
a. Inho created the NGO 'Dolphin Lovers' himself to protect marine animals.
b. Aunt Sumi and Inho planned to meet at the beach cleanup party beforehand.
c. Halla and Olle had lived in the aquarium for a decade before being released.
d. The writer played a major role in training the dolphins by teaching them essential skills.
e. The writer felt mixed emotions—sadness and happiness—during the release ceremony.
questions.explanation: a: 글에서 인호가 'Dolphin Lovers'를 창립했다는 언급이 없다. b: 글에서 아주머니와 미리 만나기로 계획했다는 언급이 없다. c: 맞다. d: 글에서 저자가 심부름만 했다고 했으므로 주요 역할을 하지 않았다. e: 맞다. 따라서 a, b, d가 틀렸다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?

You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a ⓐ great way to ⓑ ignore social issues and make the world ⓒ worse. Are you ⓓ interested? Then, ⓔ read Inho's blog below.
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'ignore(무시하다)'와 ⓒ 'worse(더 악화된)'가 문맥상 어색하다. NGO와 함께 일하는 것은 사회 문제를 무시하는 것이 아니라 해결하는 것이고, 세상을 더 악화시키는 것이 아니라 개선하는 것이어야 한다. 따라서 ⓑ와 ⓒ가 흐름상 어색하다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so (a) cleaning up beaches is considered a crucial preventive measure for marine life safety. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. (b) She was present at the scene because she is also affiliated with the same organization, Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, (c) Halla and Olle are required to acquire adaptive skills necessary for their survival in the open ocean. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. (d) My primary responsibility in today's class was to instruct the dolphins directly on how to hunt for food. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

다음 글의 흐름상, 밑줄 친 문장 (a)~(d) 중 인과관계나 전체 맥락과 다르거나 논리적으로 어색한 진술은?
questions.explanation: 문장 (d)는 '오늘 수업에서 나의 주요 책임은 돌고래들에게 먹이를 사냥하는 방법을 직접 지도하는 것이었다'고 서술하고 있습니다. 그러나 바로 다음 문장에서 '나는 오늘 훈련 수업에서 심부름을 할 뿐이었지만, 그 경험이 나를 매우 흥분시켰다'고 말하고 있습니다. 이는 명백한 모순입니다. 주요 책임(primary responsibility)이 있었다고 하면서 동시에 심부름(errands)만 했다는 것은 논리적으로 어색합니다. 따라서 정답은 ④번입니다.

questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: '특별한 : 평범한'은 반의어 관계지만, '유용한 : 도움 되는'은 유의어 관계이다.

options: He wants to __________ in a big movie someday.
The man will __________ us through the museum.
They traveled to a __________ island for vacation.
questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 단어가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
<보기> translate, capture, guide, act, faraway
questions.explanation: <보기>에 language가 없으므로 ①이 정답이다.

options: ⓐ: a program of special events or entertainment
ⓑ: a big meeting with members of the same school
ⓒ: polite ways of behaving and treating others
ⓔ: able to be done or achieved
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이로 알맞지 않은 것은?
• We went to a music ⓐfestival last night.
• Our school ⓑreunion was so much fun.
• He has good ⓒmanners at the table.
• She ⓓcaptured a beautiful photo of the sunset.
• Anything is ⓔpossible if you try.
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'capture'는 '카메라로 누군가 또는 무언가를 촬영, 녹음 또는 촬영하는 것'을 의미하며, '누군가 또는 무언가를 돌보다'는 뜻의 영영풀이로 알맞지 않다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• When I was young, I ⓐ_________ live in Seoul.
• Did you ⓑ_________ a doctor yesterday?
• When I ⓒ_________ up late, I feel tired.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 종속절인 '내가 어렸을 때'는 과거이므로 주절도 과거시제로 일치시킨다. ⓑ 일반동사 see는 조동사 Did 뒤에 동사원형으로 쓴다. ⓒ 주절 '나는 피곤함을 느낀다'가 현재시제이므로 종속절의 시제도 현재시제로 일치시킨다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은 몇 개인가?
• Suji put her glasses on the table two hours ago.
• Call me when you were ready.
• Do you go to the doctor last night?
